title: Enhancement: Add option to upgrade via local image file to DUT in `upgrade_sonic.yml`
author: Javier-Tan
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the enhancement

Add option to upgrade SONiC to SONiC vis local image file rather than URL in `upgrade_sonic.yml`

### Current Behavior

Only takes image url

### Proposed Behavior

Also take local image file

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
Sometimes we don't have a DUT reachable image-url and have to use local image file to upgrade SONiC DUT
#### How did you do it?
Add option in `upgrade_sonic.yml` to SCP file onto all listed DUTs and run `sudo sonic-installer install` - similar to passing image-url
#### How did you verify/test it?
Tested it on T2 device in lab successfully.
